rationale: HOUSEKEEPING, not a research verdict. This record is a calibration artifact: P-022 was entered into the strategy factory retrospectively to test the spec/integrity/validation agents against a case whose answer was already known by hand. It never represented a new strategy.

It cannot advance. Integrity FAILED (research/integrity/strat_p022_fade_v1_integrity_2026-08-02.json): the spec agent's entry_logic asserted that close_time is the correct close anchor on this family, which is the superseded 2026-07-26 fix. Verified by hand: src/round_leader_fade_maker.py contains zero references to close_time or occurrence_datetime and depends entirely on GolfScheduleResolver. record_validation refuses to run while integrity fails, and attach_spec refuses to replace a spec on an existing record, so this record is a permanent dead end by construction.
It is superseded. op_20260802_002 / strat_p022_fade_v2 carries the corrected spec, passed integrity, and reached validation.

Retiring it keeps the registry honest: a record parked at `spec` forever reads as work in progress. Nothing about the live P-022 pod changes — it continues in paper under its own pre-registered forward gate (T>=24, currently T=0), which no artifact in this chain touched.
